commit.message:
feat(tools)!: component library store and project persistence

The .camproj file now saves the document tool component table
(components) and each tool's component stack (assembly). The loader
reads the table and every stack before any world write, checks that each
link names a row and that each stack resolves, and lands them through
table_set and set_assembly in place of the clear-on-open. The derived
tool record and body stay as the file states them, so an open never
shifts a posted program.

A document component can link to a user library copy (library_ref: the
library id and an FNV-1a content hash). The user component library is
camcraft-components/1 in CAMCRAFT_COMPONENTS, else
<data dir>/camcraft/components/components.camcomponents, read all or
nothing and saved through a temp file and a rename. The holder library
and the starter catalog are read-only built-in components. sync_status
compares a row with its library copy and never applies it;
SyncDocumentComponent pulls the copy in and derives every user tool
again in one undo step.

The .camtools export of components is left on #3645.

BREAKING CHANGE: the project file steps to v84. A v83 build refuses the
files that this build writes; v83 and older files open unchanged.

Refs #3645

feat(tools)!: .camtools version 8 carries tool components and stacks

A tool built from tool components now rides its .camtools definition
with its stack (`assembly`), and the file holds the rows the stacks
name as a top-level `components` array, in the project's one component
wire form. Such a file says version 8 (ASSEMBLY_VERSION); a library
without a stack keeps its older number and bytes.

The reader is strict: the table is read whole (each row built again
and refused by its id), each stack must name rows of the table and
resolve, a row that no stack names is refused, and a pre-8 file that
states a table or a stack is refused. ImportTools lands the rows and
the tools in its one undo step. A document row of the same id is
reused when its content is the same and refuses the import by the id
when it differs (docs/decisions/3645-camtools-v8.md). The two older
suites that named version 8 as the first unknown number now name 9.

BREAKING CHANGE: a .camtools file with assembled tools is version 8;
builds that read version 7 and older refuse it.

Fixes #3645

fix(app): a .camtools import compares the whole row, skipped tools too

Review fix (mkinney, comment 7211141172):
- The id rule compares the whole row except the library link (the
  #3646 milling and running facts and the #3643 lathe body included),
  the same comparison as a link-only edit. A same-id row that differs
  refuses the whole import by the id before any write.
- A tool that the import skips as identical has each row of its stack
  checked by the same rule, so a changed row refuses the import also
  when other tools of the file are added.

Also: a v8 round trip of a turning stack keeps its lathe body.

Pinned by camtools_v8::a_same_id_row_with_other_facts_running_data_or_lathe_body_refuses_the_import,
camtools_v8::a_skipped_identical_tool_whose_row_changed_refuses_the_import,
camtools_v8::a_turning_stack_with_a_lathe_body_exports_and_imports_identically.

Refs #3645
